q: How do I lock in my date?
a: Your date is booked once your contract is signed and your 50% deposit is paid. Until then, the date stays open for other clients.

q: When is the rest of the payment due?
a: The remaining balance is due before final delivery.
Yes. I'm based in Atlanta and travel for bookings. Travel, lodging and meals are billed on top of your package, plus a travel day rate for time spent in transit.

q: How long until I get my photos or video?
a: Turnaround depends on the package and is written into your proposal. Rush delivery is available as an add-on.

q: Can I get the raw footage?
a: Raw footage is available as an add-on. Most clients don't need it, because you get finished, graded files.
Your package includes a set number of revisions, listed in your proposal. Extra revision rounds can be added.

q: Can I use the video in paid ads?
a: Usage rights for paid advertising and broadcast are priced separately. Tell me where the content will run and I'll include the right license in your quote.

q: Do you work alone or with a crew?
a: I shoot most projects myself and bring in a trusted crew when a project calls for it, like concept music videos, commercials and wedding bundles.

q: What if I need to reschedule?
a: Reach out as soon as you know. Rescheduling and cancellation terms are spelled out in your contract.

q: How should I prepare for my shoot?
a: After you book, you'll get a short questionnaire covering locations, wardrobe, music and the schedule, plus a reminder 48 hours before.
